title: Tutorial: Using Charmed to make an animated 3D character
author: whistling_frank
selftext:
I wrote up this tutorial describing how to use the AI tools at Charmed to make a unique animated 3D character from scratch.  
[https://charmed.ai/blog/use-ai-to-generate-a-3d-video-game-character](https://charmed.ai/blog/use-ai-to-generate-a-3d-video-game-character)

[Fig 1. Stylish hero image](https://preview.redd.it/ie7p1fxo50nc1.png?width=1080&format=png&auto=webp&s=e85aaf6f06642542d1624370b40770706d339b24)

By the end, you'll be able to export an FBX file with the mesh, materials, and animation to be imported into Blender or your game engine.  


[Fig 2. Strafing robot caught mid-stride](https://preview.redd.it/shjj13r260nc1.png?width=1270&format=png&auto=webp&s=f6c5e08dcb9882d2b36638c31799cd94ee6ee828)

My goal is to help devs go from an idea to a playable prototype as fast as possible. The more iterations you can get, the more likely you'll find something actually fun and worth the investment.
